title: PrivateCTGAN: Adapting GAN for Privacy-aware Tabular Data Sharing
summary: A research project introducing PCTGANSynthesizer, a privacy-aware variant of the tabular GAN synthesizer for sharing sensitive tabular data. It is built by subclassing CTGAN's BaseSynthesizer and directly reusing CTGAN's DataSampler and DataTransformer modules, making the standalone ctgan package the foundation it extends.
